name: Launch A — Reminder: 3 Days Before

source.primary: 24h/1h/live reminder framework extended forward to a 3-day pre-frame.
supporting: Soap Opera Sequence #5 — Urgency and CTA applied to attendance.
Expert Secrets — remind the registrant what they will be able to do after the event.

purpose: One job: turn a calendar entry into an intention. Three days out is the point where the registrant decides whether they will actually show up. Give them the outcome they will walk away with and the smallest possible preparation step.

trigger.late_registrant_rule: Registered less than 3 days out: skip this file; the 24h reminder carries the job.

email.subject_angle: "[Outcome] in 3 days — here's how to be ready"
email.body_framework: Restate date/time in the registrant's zone. Lead with the after-state: what they will know or be able to do when the session ends. Name one small preparation step (bring a number, write down one question, block the hour). Re-open the loop from the confirmation. One CTA: add to calendar / save join link.

copy_rules: Lead with the outcome, not the agenda.
No price, no countdown, no offer language.
Do not repeat the full confirmation copy; this is the third mention and must add something.
guards: `webinar_datetime` missing or past -> do not send; surface a build error.
Reschedule -> recompute from the new datetime; no duplicate 3-day send.

ghl_build.structure: Trigger: Tag Added `webinar-registered` -> Wait until `webinar_datetime` - 3 days -> If not purchased and future -> Send Email -> End.
ghl_build.notes: Keep the wait relative to `webinar_datetime`. If the registration window is shorter than the runway, this node must be skipped, not fired late.

scope.includes: Registered, not purchased, three days out.

attributes.condition: not purchased AND webinar_datetime in future
